claim: SAEPS-GN is closer than raw fixed-state curvature to exact finite-gamma scalar reduced curvature on Burgers and Allen-Cahn.
SAEPS-GN exactly recovers the reduced Hessian.
SAEPS predicts the nonlinear reoptimized reduced objective curvature.
The full coupled multi-parameter comparative geometry is empirically supported.
All valid V5 two-parameter seeds favor SAEPS over raw.
Matrix-free execution is demonstrated to n_theta=100001 and real residual dimension m=3413.
